definitions.gloss: female role; woman's part (in a play or performance)
definitions.explanation: A role portraying a female character in theater, film, or other performing arts. Particularly significant in traditional Japanese theater forms where male actors play female roles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女役|おんなやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じた→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女役|おんなやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}っている→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: In this play, the female role holds the key to the story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{女役|おんなやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In kabuki, it is a tradition for male actors to perform female roles.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧ (woman) and ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role, part). In traditional Japanese theater, the concept of men performing {女役|おんなやく} has deep cultural significance. In ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧, male actors specializing in female roles are called {女形|おやま}/{女方|おんながた}, and this specialization is passed down through family lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女役|おんなやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to play a female role
- {女役|おんなやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as the female lead
- {女役|おんなやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧: costume for a female role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女形|おんながた}→女形：12658_onnagata⟧/{女方|おんながた}: onnagata — a male kabuki actor specializing in female roles
- {男役|おとこやく}: male role — the counterpart; also significant in Takarazuka Revue
- ⟦{主役|しゅやく}→主役：04199_shuyaku⟧: lead role — the principal character regardless of gender
